LanguageData.RMush_RawButton.label: button mushroom
LanguageData.RMush_RawButton.description: Edible button mushrooms. Can be cooked in ordinary meals or eaten raw. Counts as fungus. Eating it raw or in a meal grants +3 mood for 6 hours. Only the strongest mushroom bonus applies; eating a weaker mushroom does not extend it. Normal food and ideology effects still apply.
LanguageData.RMush_PlantButton.label: button mushroom cluster
LanguageData.RMush_PlantButton.description: A cluster of button mushrooms growing directly from the soil. Grows normally at light levels up to 50%. Stronger light gradually slows growth to 50% speed at 100% light, without direct light damage. Can be sown in growing zones.
